answer_1.quote: ...we propose e-THERAPIST, a novel gender, age, persona and sentiment-aware polite and interpersonal dialogue system for psychotherapy...
answer_1.outputs: Therapeutic dialogue responses in psychotherapy conversations

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation, e-THERAPIST is evaluated w.r.t (i). attribute-success ... and (ii). language-quality - Perplexity (PPL), BERTScore-F1 (BSF1), Response-length (R_LEN).

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we ask the same six experts to evaluate the e-THERAPIST... Human evaluation metrics also includes GA_c , P_c , CT_c , P o c , IB c as attribute-success and Fluency (F), Consistency (C), and Non-Repetitiveness (N R). All dialogue interactions are evaluated on an integer Likert scale of 1-5.
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated each dialogue on a Likert scale of 1-5 for attribute-success (GA_c, P_c, CT_c, Po_c, IB_c) and language-quality (Fluency, Consistency, Non-Repetitiveness).
